# CodePipelineSystemPromptMode

How a set of system prompts combines with the ones before it (the pipeline's, then each agent's).

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Additional"` | Add these prompts after the ones before them. |
| `"Override"` | Use these prompts in place of the ones before them. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CodePipelineAgent`](code-pipeline-agent.md)
- Inside [`CodePipelineCreateRequest`](code-pipeline-create-request.md)
- Inside [`CodePipelineUpdateRequest`](code-pipeline-update-request.md)
- Inside [`CodePipelineVersion`](code-pipeline-version.md)
